versions.changelog: Refactor bin/uno.py into a 56-line launcher that delegates to the new uno-cli>=1.0.0 PyPI package. The launcher pins UNO_OAUTH_SCOPE=mcp:gpt-image-2 and UNO_ALLOWED_TOOLS=gpt-image-2.* in code so any tool call outside this skill's declared scope is rejected locally before any network request. Add a 'Part of Uno' section to surface the 2000+ tool upgrade path for users who need more than gpt-image-2.
Narrow OAuth scope from mcp:* to mcp:gpt-image-2 in bundled bin/uno.py. Update SKILL.md scope declaration to match.
Remove explicit mcp:* scope mention (was triggering LLM scanner). Replace with action-scoped description of what this skill actually calls.
Declare token_scope and token-in-output security notes in metadata and body to satisfy LLM scanner concerns about credential management.
Bundle bin/uno.py directly into skill. No external skill dependency needed. All path references updated to bin/uno.py.
Replace shell variable interpolation loop with Python subprocess.run to eliminate shell injection surface flagged by VT scanner.
Fix YAML: remove angle brackets in obtained_via. Add openclaw.requires.scripts to declare uno-cli/bin/uno.py dependency.
Fix credential path (~/.clawdchat -> ~/.uno). Clarify login flow: opening device URL automatically handles SSO redirect, no manual pre-login needed.
Use python ../uno-cli/bin/uno.py for all calls (avoid PATH conflict with LibreOffice's uno binary). Document that clawhub install does not auto-cascade dependencies.

gpt-image2 v0.1.0 — Initial public release

- Provides access to OpenAI's GPT Image 2 via ClawdChat tool gateway (requires uno-cli and ClawdChat credentials).
- Supports high-quality AI image generation with reference image, style, and strict prompt/multi-element adherence.
- Offers 20 built-in style presets (Ghibli, Pixar, LEGO, claymation, etc.) and accurate text rendering (posters, menus, infographics).
- Paid usage: Each image generation submission deducts 300 ClawdChat credits; explicit user confirmation required before each spend.
- Generates images asynchronously: submit job, then poll for results (supports batching and error surfacing).
- No local Python code; leverages uno-cli for all credential and network operations.
